name: create-event
description: Creates (schedules, books) an event or meeting on Google Calendar, timed or all-day, and invites people as attendees by email, optionally with a Google Meet link; Google emails the invitations unless sendUpdates says otherwise. calendarId defaults to "primary"; google-calendar__list-calendars supplies others. The new event's id is the eventId google-calendar__get-event, google-calendar__update-event and google-calendar__delete-event take.

start.description: RFC 3339 date-time, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.

end.description: RFC 3339 date-time, or the exclusive YYYY-MM-DD end date for an all-day event.

timeZone.description: Optional IANA time zone applied to both start and end.

addMeetLink.description: Whether to create a Google Meet conference link.

calendarId.description: Calendar identifier; defaults to the primary calendar.
